findings.source_quote: Give thanks and laud, for more is here!
findings.suggested_fix: Consider «Takk og pris, for mer er her!» to express both “give thanks” and “laud” idiomatically while retaining “is here.”
findings.translation_quote: Gi takk og lov, for mer er kommet!

findings.source_quote: Bow down in awful, holy fear-
findings.suggested_fix: Consider «Bøy deg i hellig ærefrykt—» to convey the reverential awe expressed by “awful, holy fear” in this context.
findings.translation_quote: Bøy deg i aktelsens, hellige frykt—
